property_summary: After calling DrugDealer() by the CEO address, the reference version reverts (require(msg.sender == ceoAddress) fails because ceoAddress is already the caller), while the bug version allows the call (require(msg.sender != ceoAddress) succeeds) and changes ceoAddress to the same address, making the subsequent collectDrugs call behave identically; the divergence is that the reference's DrugDealer always reverts when called by the current ceoAddress, but the bug version does not.
change_summary: -require(msg.sender == ceoAddress, "Only CEO can set new address");; +require(msg.sender != ceoAddress, "Only CEO can set new address");
